blocks.heading: Tatron
blocks.intro: A smooth-hand polyester lining fabric that finishes the inside of a garment as cleanly as the outer fabric finishes the outside — without adding bulk or trapping heat.

blocks.imageAlt: Tatron polyester lining fabric roll for jackets and blazers
blocks.heading: The Fabric Nobody Sees, Until It's Wrong
blocks.html:
Tatron — commonly known in the trade as Tetron — is a lightweight polyester lining fabric used to finish the inside of jackets, blazers and trousers. A buyer never inspects a lining the way they inspect the shell fabric, but they feel it every time the garment goes on: a lining that clings, traps heat or wears through at the seams turns a well-made outer shell into a garment that feels cheap.

We manufacture Tatron for a smooth, slightly slippery hand-feel that lets a garment slide on and off easily, in a consistent weight and finish across every roll, so a jacket lined from metre 5 feels the same as one lined from metre 500.
checklist: Smooth, low-friction hand-feel for easy garment wear
Lightweight construction that doesn't add bulk under the shell fabric
Consistent weight and finish roll to roll, manufactured in-house in Delhi

blocks.heading: Tatron FAQs
blocks.intro: Don't see your question here? Ask us directly and we'll respond within one business day.

items.q: Is Tatron the same as Tetron?
items.a: Tatron is the trade name we use for our polyester lining fabric, which is often referred to in the market as Tetron. Whichever name you use, share your garment application and we'll confirm the right weight and finish.
We supply standard shades as stock, and can match custom colours to your shell fabric on confirmed bulk orders. Share a swatch or shade reference and we'll confirm feasibility.

items.q: What is the minimum order quantity?
items.a: Minimum quantity depends on the weight grade, colour and width you need. Contact us with your requirement and we'll confirm feasible order sizes and pricing directly.

items.q: Can I get a sample before placing a bulk order?
items.a: Yes. Contact us with your product category and application, and we'll arrange a sample for evaluation before you commit to a bulk production order.

blocks.text: Tell us the weight grade, colour and quantity you need — our team will respond with pricing and lead time within one business day.
